A '''butterfly-like creature''' existed on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. With a [[Color/Legends|red]] body and large, black-spotted, yellow [[Limb/Legends|wings]], the creature appeared harmless to the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] native [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like creatures, which sometimes waited on [[victoria]]s and attempted to catch the flying creatures on their tongues. However, the butterfly-like creature was actually [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] and powerful enough to lift a the frog-like creature into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]. The creature's flexible body expanded to accommodate the size of its prey, allowing it to devour its meal whole while still in flight.<ref name="SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This butterfly-like creature goes unnamed during its brief appearance in "[[The Season Scepter]],"<ref name="SS" /> the thirteenth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series. "The Season Scepter," written by [[Bob Carrau]] and directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]], first aired on [[November 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
